post.description: Emails a six-digit code. Nothing but the attempt is created until the code is verified. Send exactly one of `organizationName` (the user becomes the Owner of a new Organization) or `invitationToken` (the user joins the inviting Organization). An address that already has an account gets the same answer and a notice instead of a code.
